caption: The drawing depicts a detailed architectural element with a central, ornate, and symmetrical structure in the main portion of the image. The main object is a three-dimensional decorative stone or plaster element, rendered in shades of light beige and tan with subtle brown and gray shadows to give it depth and a sense of texture. The main shape is broadly shield-like with curving edges, scroll-like volutes on each side, and a prominent raised diamond-shaped detail in the middle. At the bottom, the structure sits on a rectangular base. In the upper left corner of the drawing, there are two smaller, linear sketches in pencil: one is a side elevation view of the same object showing its profile, and the other is a top-down outline showing the intricate ornamental curves at the top. The background is a plain, light-colored paper, and there are faintly visible pencil markings and annotations around the objects.
title: Marble Ornament (from top of mantelpiece)
